title: Best Content Strategists (2026): Plan Content That Gets Results
description: How to hire a content strategist for a content plan, topics, calendar and measurement: research, deliverables, how to brief it, price drivers and red flags.
intro: Content strategists decide what content your business should create, for whom, where and why: blog topics, guides, videos, newsletters and social content connected to business goals. A good strategy focuses effort on topics your audience cares about and measures what works. Strategies go wrong when they produce long topic lists without priorities, ignore search and customer data, or cannot be executed by your team. This guide helps you get a content plan that leads to results.

faq.q: What does a content strategy include?
faq.a: Typically audience research, goals, content pillars, a topic list with priorities, formats, a calendar and success measures.

faq.q: Is this the same as content writing?
faq.a: No. Strategy decides what to create; writing creates it. Some freelancers offer both.
From customer questions, search data, competitor gaps and business goals.

faq.q: How long does a strategy last?
faq.a: Often three to twelve months, with regular reviews.
